summary: Iter 620 Compliance Salary Process bug-fix verification. Backend engine math (utils/compliance_salary.py::_proration_factor + compute_compliance_row) verified via pytest — 14/14 PASS. Critical invariants confirmed: (a) working_days method returns PF=1357 at BOTH month_days=26 and month_days=30 for monthly 14000 / pf_basic 14000 / pd=21 — matches the SEO GROWTH prod sheet; (b) calendar_days method returns PF=1176 at pd=21/month=30 (regression); (c) attendance_days matches calendar for month=30 (÷30); (d) paid_days/none behave per spec; (e) zero-day guard returns stat_wage_base=0, pf_employee=0, esic_employee=0 while keeping pf_eligible=True/esic_eligible=True so the grid can re-enable them after typing days. Frontend code inspection of /app/frontend/app/compliance-salary-run.tsx confirms all 3 UI fixes are wired correctly: pfProrationFactor helper (L1523-1531) is an exact JS mirror of _proration_factor; updatePresentDays (L1733) uses pfRatio = pfProrationFactor(stat.pf_proration_method, pd, monthDays) for PF computation while earnings heads stay on present÷month_days; updateRowField OT/Others path (L1582-1583) also uses pfProrationFactor with the configured method; stat_wage_base recompute (L1932-1934) is max(rHeads.basic, grossEarn×floorPct) when grossEarn>0 else 0 (fixes Bug 2); deleteRun (L1070) awaits loadRuns() after successful delete before showMsg (fixes Bug 3). Frontend loads without red screen and Compliance Salary Process wizard is fully rendered with seeded super admin session (testtok_iter620_4a7b591f). End-to-end UI E2E (create fresh test firm + monthly employee + toggle Compliance Settings pf_proration_method to working_days + salary process + reprocess + delete) was NOT executed automatically to avoid touching Kankani prod data as explicitly requested in the review; code-level + engine-level verification proves the math will produce the expected values in the browser.

updatePresentDays L1730: `ratio = pd / monthDays` is still used for earning heads (basic, hra, ...) which is CORRECT per the fix scope — proration method only affects PF/ESIC wage calc; earnings prorate by month days always. Just noting the intentional dual-ratio design.

updateRowField OT/Others path (L1582): mirrors PF recompute inside the ot_pay/others branch — beware code duplication with updatePresentDays PF block; extracting a computePfEmployeeAndEmployer(row, cfg, pd, monthDays) helper would halve the surface area.

deleteRun (L1051-1078): awaits loadRuns() only when r.deleted is true. If the DELETE returns approval_required (deletion pending super admin), the runs list is NOT refreshed — that is intentional (nothing changed) but worth confirming behaviour matches product expectation.

stat_wage_base recompute (L1932-1934) uses rHeads.basic (rounded) instead of paidBasic (raw). This is consistent with the whole-rupee display and slightly under-reports the base by <₹1 vs the server's pre-reconcile value — non-issue for the user's bug but noted.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 RCA (confirmed by code + tests): grid recompute in updatePresentDays previously computed pfRatio = pd / monthDays unconditionally, but the server _proration_factor divides by 26 when the firm's pf_proration_method='working_days'. Result: on-screen PF (client) = 12%×14000×21/30 = 1176 while server saved PF = 12%×14000×21/26 = 1357, so PF flipped on Save + Reprocess. Fix: pfProrationFactor(method, pd, monthDays) helper introduced and called at L1733 (updatePresentDays) and L1582 (updateRowField OT/Others path). Verified via pytest — engine returns 1357 for both month_days=26 and 30 with working_days method. Bug 2 RCA: fresh-process rows arrive with stat_wage_base=0 (zero-pay guard) and the old client recompute never rebuilt it — L1932-1934 now computes max(rHeads.basic, grossEarn×floorPct) when grossEarn>0. Bug 3 RCA: deleteRun previously set setRun(null) but did NOT refresh the local runs list, so the next 'Salary Process' click still saw the deleted run in the list and offered the Reprocess dialog. Fix: await loadRuns() after setRun(null) at L1070.
